name: Daniel
label: Long-time daily listener, value-minded
who: I have been a Spotify Premium subscriber for a long time and use it every day, including in the car. I value the no-ads listening, the skips, and offline playback, and I think the subscription is one of the best deals I pay for.
value_for_money: Strongly positive: they call Premium worth every penny, a bang-for-the-buck subscription, and a small cost compared with the time they get from it. The complaints are about ads growing over time and bundled perks being removed without a price change.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: daily use, no ads, offline listening, and a long history with the service. Things that would weaken that loyalty: ads becoming heavier and bundled perks being removed.
pain_points: Ads have become excessive over time
Bundled perks removed without any change in price
Feels the free tier is designed to push users to pay
reasons_to_stay: They keep paying because they listen every day and value no ads, skips, and offline downloads, which they say make the subscription worth it. Even with complaints about ads and removed perks, they still think Premium is one of the best subscriptions they have.
tone: Enthusiastic and fairly relaxed, with a mix of casual wording and firm opinions.
